articles.title_en: Package: We can talk about the term of office of the secretary, but we can't introduce it retroactively
articles.lead_en: A group of senators wants the Constitutional Court to abolish the recently introduced five-year term of office for city and municipal secretaries and regional directors. We do not understand the Constitutional Court as the third parliamentary chamber to end a political battle, but as the guardian of the constitution, the correct principles of state governance and legal certainty, says for Radiojournal the Chairman of the Senate Standing Committee on the Constitution of the Czech Republic and parliamentary procedure Stanislav Balík.
